records.name: event.booth.configurator.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form js_class="event_booth_configurator_form">
                <group>
                    <field name="product_id" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="event_id" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}" domain="[                                 ('event_booth_ids.product_id', '=', product_id),                                 ('is_finished', '=', False)                            ]"/>
                    <field name="event_booth_category_available_ids" invisible="1"/>
                    <field name="event_booth_category_id" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}" invisible="not event_id" domain="[('id', 'in', event_booth_category_available_ids)]"/>
                    <field name="event_booth_ids" options="{'no_open': True, 'no_create': True}" widget="many2many_checkboxes" invisible="not event_booth_category_id" domain="[                                 ('event_id', '=', event_id),                                 ('booth_category_id', '=', event_booth_category_id),                                 ('product_id', '=', product_id),                                 ('state', '=', 'available')                            ]"/>
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button string="Ok" class="btn-primary" special="save"/>
                    <button string="Cancel" class="btn-secondary" special="cancel"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
